title: Machine learning for environmental engineering and science
description: Aimed at understanding and testing state-of?the-art methods in machine learning applied to environmental sciences and engineering problems. Potential applications include but are not limited to remote sensing, and environmental and geophysical fluid dynamics. Includes testing "vanilla" ML algorithms, feedforward neural networks, random forests, shallow vs deep networks, and the details of machine learning techniques
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: Computer language Python or Julia, some linear algebra and machine learning.
raw_title_text: EAEE E4000 Machine learning for environmental engineering and science. 3.00 points .
